terminal.description: The terminal device (e.g., /dev/tty1) used to run the greeter.

greeter_path.description: Absolute path to the greeter executable (e.g., /usr/bin/greetd-gtk-greeter).

greeter_args.description: List of arguments passed to the greeter on startup (e.g., ["--theme", "dark"]).

session_cmd_template.description: Command template used to launch the user's session. Use `{{ user }}` and `{{ session_cmd }}` as placeholders. The template will be rendered with actual user/session values.

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent login sessions allowed.

auto_login.description: Enable automatic login after a timeout (if set to true).

auto_login_user.description: Username to auto-login (only used when `auto_login` is enabled).

auto_login_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds before auto-login triggers. Set to 0 to disable auto-login timeout.

seat.description: The seat (e.g., seat0) to manage. Most systems use seat0.

ttys.description: List of additional TTYs (e.g., ["tty2", "tty3"]) where greetd should spawn login sessions.

pam_service.description: Name of the PAM service configuration to use for authentication.
